note: The maintainer's own 48x48 pixel art, stored byte-for-byte as delivered. NEVER re-encode, resize or resample one — this project does not ship softened pixel art. Draw them at whole multiples of 48 only, with image-rendering: pixelated. 'rune' is the DEFAULT for any chapter that does not name an icon. Icons marked used_by: null are unassigned and available for future writing — keep them.
